items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I think I remember seeing Celestine. He's one of the first fellas that I can remember seeing and identifying with bands

ctx.x: Do you remember which bands they were? The name of any other?
No, but I think I remember seeing Celestine. He's one of the first fellas that I can remember seeing and identifying with bands, as well as a man by the name of Ridgely.
Yeah, he's still living up there.
